name: Calm
overview: Scripture reveals that true calm is found in trusting the Lord’s sovereign power and presence, as He fights on our behalf and grants peace amid turmoil. The psalmist expresses confidence in God's protection and provision, resting securely beside still waters and experiencing joy in His presence. God's command to 'be still and know that I am God' calls believers to cease striving and acknowledge His control, just as He calms the storms and stills the waves, demonstrating His authority over all circumstances.
